normalSaveScope.explanation: Runtime source hash exactly matches normal-saved canonical disk content. No preSave in-memory snapshot file was captured; metadata/revision byte identity with that memory snapshot is not claimed. NormalSave v4→v5 normalization and explicit synthetic parameter materialization change canonical content relative to raw missing-experiment input.

heatAudit.statusScope: Existing actual heat-audit response inspected; formula recomputed only from already-produced sample values, not thermal solve/MMS.

interpretation.transientBaseline: Steady initialization with no scheduled nonzero-time keyframes and no online commands; recorded state arrays are a constant baseline. This is genuine time-marching product completion, not a new disturbed-transient or MMS validation.
interpretation.syntheticParameters: Saved synthetic/mock parameter pack and primary circuit are disclosed and hash-bound; no measured/calibrated vendor data claim.
interpretation.physicalCorrectnessScope: Recorded numerical convergence, conservation diagnostics and existing HeatAudit closure inspected; no independent PDE/DAE recomputation, gradient/AD test or MMS rerun.
